pages.ocr_text: TRD Not your average four-door. We’ve turned our Toyota Racing Development (TRD) engineers loose on Camry, improving handling, performance and styling. Aerodynamic elements, from the front splitter and the side aero skirts to the rear diffuser and spoiler, boost Camry TRD’s bold impression and help enhance high-speed stability. TRD 19-in. alloy wheels with red-painted calipers Matte-black alloy wheels on TRD not only look good, but also reduce weight and enhance steering responsiveness. Large 12.9-in.-diameter front rotors and red-painted dual-piston front calipers are designed to give impressive stopping power on every twist and turn. TRD purposeful stance TRD-tuned shocks help enhance body control, handling agility and steering precision. Thicker underbody braces increase torsional rigidity, and unique coil springs not only drop the vehicle .60 inches for a lower center of gravity, but also enhance the aero kit's downforce and aggressive look. TRD cat-back dual exhaust Hit the gas and enjoy the sound of TRD's standard 301-hp 3.5L V6. The cat-back dual exhaust releases a throatier sound with every press of the pedal. Polished stainless steel TRD exhaust tips punctuate its athletic look.

This page presents a comparative overview of three Toyota Camry models—XSE V6, TRD, and LE Hybrid—detailing their mechanical, exterior, interior, audio multimedia, safety features, and available packages/options. The information is organized into three distinct columns, each highlighting the specific features and upgrades for that model, with checkmarks indicating included features and footnotes providing additional context. The layout uses bold headings and bullet points to clearly differentiate between model categories and feature types.

**Text Evidence:**
- XSE V6 adds or replaces features offered on XSE, including a 3.5L V6 engine with 301 hp and a panoramic glass roof.
- TRD adds or replaces features offered on SE, featuring a 3.5L V6 with 301 hp, TRD track-tuned suspension, and a gloss-black front grille.
- LE Hybrid includes a hybrid engine (2.5L 4-Cylinder with 208 net hp), bi-LED headlights, and dual-zone automatic climate control.
- All models include Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5+ (TSS 2.5+) and ten airbags.
- The LE Hybrid's Convenience Package includes HomeLink® universal transceiver and an auto-dimming rearview mirror.
- The TRD model offers a Driver Assist Package with ventilated front seats and a two-tone exterior color option.

This is a great way to add extra personality to your Camry. Not every accessory is available in your area, so for a complete list of accessories, go to toyota.com/camry/accessories. WARRANTIES Every Toyota Car, Truck and SUV is built to exceptional standards. And that's not idle boasting. We back it up with these Limited Warranty Coverages: Basic: 36 months/36,000 miles (all components other than normal wear and maintenance items). Hybrid-Related Component Coverage: Hybrid-related components, including the battery control module, hybrid control module and inverter with converter, are covered for 8 years/100,000 miles. Refer to applicable Warranty and Maintenance Guide for details. Hybrid Battery: HV battery is covered for 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first. Warranty coverage is subject to terms and conditions. Refer to applicable Warranty and Maintenance Guide for details. Powertrain: 60 months/60,000 miles (engine, transmission/transaxle, drive system, seatbelts and airbags). Rust-Through: 60 months/unlimited miles (corrosion perforation of sheet metal). Emissions: Coverages vary under Federal and California regulations. Refer to applicable Warranty and Maintenance Guide for details. Accessories: For Genuine Toyota Accessories purchased at the time of the new vehicle purchase, the Toyota Accessory Warranty coverage is in effect for 36 months/36,000 miles from the vehicle's in-service date, which is the same coverage as the Toyota New Vehicle Limited Warranty. For Genuine Toyota Accessories purchased after the new vehicle purchase the coverage is 12 months, regardless of mileage, from the date the accessory was installed on the vehicle, or the remainder of any applicable new vehicle warranty, whichever provides greater coverage. You may be eligible for transportation assistance if it's necessary that your vehicle be kept overnight for repairs covered under warranty. Please see your authorized Toyota dealership for further details. For complete details about Toyota's warranties, please visit www toyota.com, refer to the applicable Warranty and Maintenance Guide or see your Toyota dealer.

pages.summary:
This page presents a comprehensive feature comparison chart for the Toyota Camry, detailing exterior and interior specifications across multiple trim levels including LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, and XSE Hybrid. The table uses symbols (S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package) to indicate the availability of features such as LED headlights, various grille options, wheel types, climate control systems, infotainment displays, seating materials, and advanced driver assistance features. The layout is structured with clear headings for "Exterior" and "Interior," allowing for easy cross-comparison between different models.

**Text Evidence:**
- The page is titled "CAMRY FEATURES" and includes a legend defining S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package.
- Features are categorized under "Exterior" and "Interior" sections.
- The table compares 13 different Camry models across numerous features like headlights, grilles, wheels, climate control, seats, and technology.
- A note at the bottom directs readers to "See numbered footnotes in Disclosures section."

**Visual Evidence:**
<table_summary>Table: Camry Features Comparison - This table compares 13 different Camry trim levels (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, XSE Hybrid) against a list of exterior and interior features. The presence of a feature is indicated by 'S' (Standard), 'O' (Optional), or 'P' (Available as part of a package).</table_summary>

SECTION: Camry Features (Pages 16-22)

TOPICS: feature comparison, trim levels, exterior features, interior features, infotainment systems, safety systems, mechanical specifications, packages and options

TEXT_EVIDENCE:
- Page 16: The page presents a comprehensive feature comparison chart for the Toyota Camry across 13 trim levels (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, XSE Hybrid), using S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package to indicate availability of features such as LED headlights, grille options, wheels, climate control, infotainment displays, seating materials, and advanced driver assistance features. The table is structured with "Exterior" and "Interior" sections. A note at the bottom directs readers to "See numbered footnotes in Disclosures section." (Page 16)
- Page 17: This page presents a comprehensive feature comparison table for the Camry vehicle, detailing interior options across various trim levels (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, XSE Hybrid). The table uses "S" for Standard, "O" for Optional, and "P" for Available as part of a package to indicate the availability of features such as climate control, infotainment displays, seating, and safety systems. Key differences are highlighted between standard and hybrid models, with features like the 7-inch TFT Multi-Information Display being optional on some trims. The 4.2-in. TFT Multi-Information Display is standard on most non-hybrid trims but includes additional features like TRD start-up animation and hybrid system information on specific models. The Tire Pressure Monitor System (TPMS) is standard on all trims except the LE Hybrid and SE Hybrid, where it is optional. (Page 17)
- Page 18: This page (Page 43) is a continuation of the "CAMRY FEATURES" section, presenting a comprehensive table that details the interior features available across various Camry trim levels. The table compares features from the LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, and several Hybrid variants. It uses 'S' for Standard, 'P' for Optional, and 'O' for Available as part of a package to indicate feature availability. Key features listed include seating configurations, steering wheel options, infotainment systems, climate controls, and safety technologies like Dynamic Radar Cruise Control and Lane Departure Alert. The legend at the top right defines the symbols used in the table. (Page 18)
- Page 19: This page provides a detailed comparison of audio multimedia and connected services features across various Toyota Camry trim levels, including LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, and XSE Hybrid. The information is organized into two main sections: "Audio Multimedia" and "Connected Services," each with a table listing features and their availability (Standard, Optional, or Available as part of a package). Key features include different touchscreen sizes, speaker configurations (including JBL®), compatibility with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, SiriusXM® with trial subscriptions, and various connected services like Safety Connect®, Service Connect, Remote Connect, and Wi-Fi Connect, all dependent on a 4G network. The Audio section details four tiers: Audio (7-in. touchscreen), Audio Plus (9.0-in. touchscreen), Audio Plus with JBL® (nine speakers), and JBL® Premium Audio (14 speakers). The Connected Services section lists four services: Safety Connect® (1-year trial), Service Connect (up to 10-year trial), Remote Connect (1-year trial), and Wi-Fi Connect (30-day or up to 3 GB trial). All connected services are noted as being "4G network dependent." A legend at the top right defines S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package. Footnotes provide additional details, such as the 3-month Platinum Plan trial for SiriusXM® and the requirement for a subscription after the trial period for most services. (Page 19)
- Page 20: This page provides a detailed comparison of safety, convenience, and mechanical features across various Toyota Camry models, including standard (S), optional (P), and package-available (O) features. The information is organized in a comprehensive table format that spans multiple sections: Safety and Convenience, Packages and Options, and Mechanical/Performance. Key features include the Star Safety System™, Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5+, blind spot monitoring, various engine types (including hybrid), transmission options, and specific dimensions for different trim levels. The table uses symbols (S, P, O) to indicate feature availability. The page details the "Star Safety System™" which includes Enhanced Vehicle Stability Control (VSC), Traction Control (TRAC), Anti-lock Brake System (ABS), Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), Brake Assist (BA), and Smart Stop Technology® (SST). It lists ten airbags as standard on all models. The "Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5+" system is available on most models, with variations between standard and hybrid versions. The table shows that the Hybrid models have a 650V traction battery and a hybrid system net power of 208 HP. Dimensions such as overall length, width, height, wheelbase, and ground clearance are provided for each model. (Page 20)
- Page 21: This page presents a comprehensive table detailing the features and options available across various Camry vehicle packages, including LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, and several hybrid variants. The table uses symbols (S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package) to indicate the availability of features such as the Convenience Package, Audio Upgrade Package, Navigation Upgrade Package, Driver Assist Package, Cold Weather Package, and All-season tires. Key features like the Smart Key System, HomeLink universal transceiver, 9-inch touchscreen, JBL speakers, Panoramic View Monitor, and adaptive headlights are listed with their availability across different models. The Convenience Package includes the Smart Key System, HomeLink universal transceiver, and auto-dimming rearview mirror. The Audio Upgrade Package includes an Audio Plus system with a 9-inch touchscreen and Qi-compatible wireless smartphone charging. The Navigation Upgrade Package includes Premium Audio with Dynamic Navigation, a 9-inch touchscreen, and nine JBL speakers. The Driver Assist Package includes a 10-inch color Head-Up Display (HUD), Panoramic View Monitor, and Front and Rear Parking Assist. The Cold Weather Package includes heated steering wheel, heated front seats, and heated power outside mirrors. All-season tires are standard on all models except for the LE and LE Hybrid, which have summer tires as standard. (Page 21)
- Page 22: This page presents a comprehensive table of mechanical and performance specifications for the Camry vehicle across multiple trim levels (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, and various hybrid variants). The table details engine types, horsepower, torque, compression ratios, emission ratings, electric motor output, battery type, and voltage. Key information includes the standard availability of a 2.5-Liter Dynamic Force 4-Cylinder engine with DOHC D-4S Injection and Dual Variable Valve Timing (VVT-i) in most models, while the XSE V6 and XLE V6 models feature a 3.5-Liter V6 engine. Hybrid models are indicated by an 'S' or 'O' symbol, with 'S' denoting standard equipment and 'O' indicating optional. The table also specifies that the sealed lithium-ion battery is standard on all hybrid models. The 2.5-Liter Dynamic Force 4-Cylinder engine is standard on LE, XLE, SE, and SE Nightshade trims. The 3.5-Liter V6 engine is standard on XLE V6, XSE, and XSE V6 trims. All hybrid models have a power output of 118 HP (88 kW) and a torque of 149 lb.-ft. (202 N-m). The sealed lithium-ion (LI) battery is standard on all hybrid models. The compression ratio varies between 13.0:1 and 14.0:1 depending on the model. (Page 22)

pages.summary:
This page presents a comprehensive feature comparison chart for the Toyota Camry, detailing exterior and interior specifications across multiple trim levels including LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, and XSE Hybrid. The table uses symbols (S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package) to indicate the availability of features such as LED headlights, various grille options, wheel types, climate control systems, infotainment displays, seating materials, and advanced driver assistance features. The layout is structured with clear headings for "Exterior" and "Interior," allowing for easy cross-comparison between different models.

**Text Evidence:**
- The page is titled "CAMRY FEATURES" and includes a legend defining S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package.
- Features are categorized under "Exterior" and "Interior" sections.
- The table compares 13 different Camry models across numerous features like headlights, grilles, wheels, climate control, seats, and technology.
- A note at the bottom directs readers to "See numbered footnotes in Disclosures section."

**Visual Evidence:**
<table_summary>Table: Camry Features Comparison - This table compares 13 different Camry trim levels (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, XSE Hybrid) against a list of exterior and interior features. The presence of a feature is indicated by 'S' (Standard), 'O' (Optional), or 'P' (Available as part of a package).</table_summary>

- All connected services are noted as being "4G network dependent."
- A legend at the top right defines S = Standard, O = Optional, P = Available as part of a package.
- Footnotes provide additional details, such as the 3-month Platinum Plan trial for SiriusXM® and the requirement for a subscription after the trial period for most services.

pages.summary:
This page provides a detailed comparison of safety, convenience, and mechanical features across various Toyota Camry models, including standard (S), optional (P), and package-available (O) features. The information is organized in a comprehensive table format that spans multiple sections: Safety and Convenience, Packages and Options, Mechanical/Performance, and Dimensions. Key features include the Star Safety System™, Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5+, blind spot monitoring, various engine types (including hybrid), transmission options, and specific dimensions for different trim levels. The table uses symbols (S, P, O) to indicate feature availability.

**Text Evidence:**
- The page details the "Star Safety System™" which includes Enhanced Vehicle Stability Control (VSC), Traction Control (TRAC), Anti-lock Brake System (ABS), Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), Brake Assist (BA), and Smart Stop Technology® (SST).
- It lists ten airbags as standard on all models.
- The "Toyota Safety Sense™ 2.5+" system is available on most models, with variations between standard and hybrid versions.
- The table shows that the Hybrid models have a 650V traction battery and a hybrid system net power of 208 HP.
- Dimensions such as overall length, width, height, wheelbase, and ground clearance are provided for each model.

**Visual Evidence:**
<table_summary>Table: Camry Features - This table compares the standard (S), optional (P), and package-available (O) features across 14 different Camry models (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, LE Hybrid, SE Hybrid, SE Hybrid Nightshade, XLE Hybrid, XSE Hybrid). The columns are divided into three main sections: Safety and Convenience, Packages and Options, and Mechanical/Performance.</table_summary>

SECTION: Camry Specifications (Pages 22-25)

TOPICS: mechanical and performance specifications, transmission and drivetrain, dimensions and weights, fuel economy, tire specifications, hybrid systems, safety features, connected services

TEXT_EVIDENCE:
- The 2.5-Liter Dynamic Force 4-Cylinder engine is standard on LE, XLE, SE, and SE Nightshade trims (Page 22)
- The 3.5-Liter V6 engine is standard on XLE V6, XSE, and XSE V6 trims (Page 22)
- All hybrid models have a power output of 118 HP (88 kW) and a torque of 149 lb.-ft. (202 N-m) (Page 22)
- The sealed lithium-ion (LI) battery is standard on all hybrid models (Page 22)
- Compression ratio varies between 13.0:1 and 14.0:1 depending on the model (Page 22)
- Standard equipment is marked with "S", optional features with "O" (Page 23)
- Transmission includes Direct Shift-8AT 8-speed electronically controlled automatic (ECT-i) with sequential shift mode (Page 23)
- Drivetrain options are Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD) (Page 23)
- Body construction features unitized body with front and rear anti-vibration sub-frames (Page 23)
- Suspension varies from independent MacPherson strut front with gas-filled shock absorbers to more advanced systems with sport-tuned shocks and coil springs (Page 23)
- Brakes include power-assisted ventilated 12-in. front disc brakes and solid 11.06-in. rear disc brakes with hydraulic brake booster (Page 23)
- The document is titled "CAMRY SPECIFICATIONS" and includes a legend indicating S = Standard, O = Optional (Page 24)
- The "Dimensions" section provides exterior and interior measurements in inches, including overall height, width, length, wheelbase, ground clearance, track, head room, shoulder room, hip room, and leg room (Page 24)
- The "Weights and Capacities" section lists curb weight, EPA passenger volume (with and without moonroof), cargo volume, fuel tank capacity, and seating capacity (Page 24)
- The "Tires" section specifies tire types, with 'S' for standard and 'O' for optional summer tires (Page 24)
- The "Mileage Estimates" section provides fuel economy in mpg city/highway/combined for Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD) (Page 24)
- Projected EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings are provided for multiple 2024 Camry models, including 28 city/39 hwy/32 combined mpg for the LE, SE, and SE Nightshade Edition (Page 25)
- A 51 city/53 hwy/52 combined mpg rating is listed for the 2024 Camry LE Hybrid (Page 25)
- Numerous disclaimers detail the conditions for using Toyota's Connected Services, noting that operability depends on cellular network availability, a cellular connection, and GPS signal (Page 25)
- The text specifies that an active Remote Connect trial or subscription is required to use certain features (Page 25)
- Warnings are included for safety features, stating that systems like the Pre-Collision System and Lane Departure Alert are not substitutes for safe and attentive driving (Page 25)
- The page mentions that the Wi-Fi Connect trial begins at enrollment and expires after 3GB of data use or one month (Page 25)
- It states that the Service Connect trial period is at no extra cost and begins on the original date of purchase or lease of a new vehicle (Page 25)

The table uses "S" to denote standard equipment and "O" for optional features, clearly indicating which components are included in each model variant. Key differences include transmission types, drivetrain options (front-wheel vs. all-wheel drive), suspension systems, and braking technologies.

**Text Evidence:**
- Standard equipment is marked with "S", optional features with "O"
- Transmission includes Direct Shift-8AT 8-speed electronically controlled automatic (ECT-i) with sequential shift mode
- Drivetrain options are Front-Wheel Drive (FWD) and All-Wheel Drive (AWD)
- Body construction features unitized body with front and rear anti-vibration sub-frames
- Suspension varies from independent MacPherson strut front with gas-filled shock absorbers to more advanced systems with sport-tuned shocks and coil springs
- Brakes include power-assisted ventilated 12-in. front disc brakes and solid 11.06-in. rear disc brakes with hydraulic brake booster

The data is structured in tables comparing various models (LE, XLE, XLE V6, SE, SE Nightshade, XSE, XSE V6, TRD, and hybrid variants) across different attributes. - The document is titled "CAMRY SPECIFICATIONS" and includes a legend indicating S = Standard, O = Optional.

This page, titled "DISCLOSURES," contains a comprehensive list of numbered footnotes providing detailed information about the 2024 Toyota Camry. The content covers fuel economy ratings for various models (e.g., 28 city/39 hwy/32 combined mpg for the LE), technical specifications for features like Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and extensive legal disclaimers regarding connected services such as Safety Connect, Remote Connect, and Destination Assist. These disclaimers emphasize that service operability depends on external factors like cellular network availability and GPS signal, and they include details about trial periods, subscription requirements, data charges, and privacy practices. The page also includes warnings about safety systems like Pre-Collision System and Lane Departure Alert, advising drivers not to rely exclusively on them.

**Text Evidence:**
- Projected EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings are provided for multiple 2024 Camry models, including 28 city/39 hwy/32 combined mpg for the LE, SE, and SE Nightshade Edition.
- A 51 city/53 hwy/52 combined mpg rating is listed for the 2024 Camry LE Hybrid.
- Numerous disclaimers detail the conditions for using Toyota's Connected Services, noting that operability depends on cellular network availability, a cellular connection, and GPS signal.
- The text specifies that an active Remote Connect trial or subscription is required to use certain features.
- Warnings are included for safety features, stating that systems like the Pre-Collision System and Lane Departure Alert are not substitutes for safe and attentive driving.
- The page mentions that the Wi-Fi Connect trial begins at enrollment and expires after 3GB of data use or one month.
- It states that the Service Connect trial period is at no extra cost and begins on the original date of purchase or lease of a new vehicle.

**Visual Evidence:**

sections.summary:
SECTION: Disclosures (Pages 25-26)

TOPICS: fuel economy ratings, connected services disclaimers, safety system limitations, vehicle feature descriptions, ToyotaCare coverage, regional applicability, legal disclaimers

TEXT_EVIDENCE:
- Projected EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings are provided for multiple 2024 Camry models, including 28 city/39 hwy/32 combined mpg for the LE, SE, and SE Nightshade Edition (Page 25)
- A 51 city/53 hwy/52 combined mpg rating is listed for the 2024 Camry LE Hybrid (Page 25)
- Numerous disclaimers detail the conditions for using Toyota's Connected Services, noting that operability depends on cellular network availability, a cellular connection, and GPS signal (Page 25)
- The text specifies that an active Remote Connect trial or subscription is required to use certain features (Page 25)
- Warnings are included for safety features, stating that systems like the Pre-Collision System and Lane Departure Alert are not substitutes for safe and attentive driving (Page 25)
- The Wi-Fi Connect trial begins at enrollment and expires after 3GB of data use or one month (Page 25)
- The Service Connect trial period is at no extra cost and begins on the original date of purchase or lease of a new vehicle (Page 25)
- Brake Hold may keep brakes engaged after a complete stop when in Drive (Page 26)
- Vehicle Stability Control (VSC) helps maintain control but is not a substitute for safe driving (Page 26)
- Smart Stop Technology® reduces power during certain brake and accelerator pedal applications (Page 26)
- Whiplash-Injury-Lessening front seats can reduce whiplash severity in rear-end collisions (Page 26)
- Hill Start Assist Control minimizes backward rolling on steep ascents (Page 26)
- ToyotaCare covers maintenance for two years or 25,000 miles and includes 24-hour Roadside Assistance for two years with unlimited mileage (Page 26)
- The Rear-Seat Reminder recognizes a unique rear-door opening pattern, not objects in the rear seat (Page 26)
- The backup camera does not provide a comprehensive view; drivers should look over their shoulder (Page 26)
- All information is subject to change and pertains specifically to mainland U.S.A. vehicles only (Page 26)

pages.summary:
This page contains a series of numbered disclosures (47-54) detailing various vehicle safety and feature limitations, including Brake Hold, Vehicle Stability Control, Smart Stop Technology, Whiplash-Injury-Lessening seats, Hill Start Assist Control, and the Rear-Seat Reminder. It also provides information about ToyotaCare coverage, which includes normal factory scheduled maintenance for two years or 25,000 miles and 24-hour Roadside Assistance for two years with unlimited mileage, noting specific exclusions and regional availability. The text emphasizes that all information is based on data available at the time of posting, pertains to mainland U.S.A. vehicles only, and may be subject to change without notice.

**Text Evidence:**
- Brake Hold may keep brakes engaged after a complete stop when in Drive.
- Vehicle Stability Control (VSC) helps maintain control but is not a substitute for safe driving.
- Smart Stop Technology® reduces power during certain brake and accelerator pedal applications.
- Whiplash-Injury-Lessening front seats can reduce whiplash severity in rear-end collisions.
- Hill Start Assist Control minimizes backward rolling on steep ascents.
- ToyotaCare covers maintenance for two years or 25,000 miles and includes 24-hour Roadside Assistance for two years with unlimited mileage.
- The Rear-Seat Reminder recognizes a unique rear-door opening pattern, not objects in the rear seat.
- The backup camera does not provide a comprehensive view; drivers should look over their shoulder.
- All information is subject to change and pertains specifically to mainland U.S.A. vehicles only.
